item.tib: bdag srung ye shes gur khang
item.coloph: srung ba dbal gyi gur khang gi brgyud rim ni/ bon sku kun tu bzang pos gshen 'chi med gtsug phud la brgyud/ des sprul sku pad ma 'byung gnas la brgyud/ des ye shes mtsho rgyal la brgyud/ des dus mtha'i rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal la gzhi bdag gnyan po klu btsan zhol du/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
